description: This file contains unit tests for Azure Table Storage-based reminder services in an Orleans-based project. It includes test classes, fixture setup, and numerous test methods verifying reminder functionalities, failover, multi-silo scenarios, and related behaviors.

classes.name: ReminderTests_AzureTable
classes.description: Unit test class for Azure Table Reminder Service operations, including basic, failover, multi-silo, and churn scenarios.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Test fixture class for configuring and setting up Azure Orleans test clusters.

classes.name: SiloConfigurator
classes.description: Configures individual silos within the test cluster to use Azure Table reminders.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster, adding the silo builder configurator.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures each silo to use Azure Table Reminder service with test defaults.

methods.name: ReminderTests_AzureTable
methods.description: Constructor initializing the test class with the fixture.

methods.name: Rem_Azure_Basic_StopByRef
methods.description: Tests basic reminder start/stop by reference.

methods.name: Rem_Azure_Basic_ListOps
methods.description: Test for basic list operations, currently skipped due to issue.

methods.name: Rem_Azure_1J_MultiGrainMultiReminders
methods.description: Tests multi-grain, multi-reminder scenario in a single silo.

methods.name: Rem_Azure_ReminderNotFound
methods.description: Test to verify behavior when reminder is not found.

methods.name: Rem_Azure_Basic
methods.description: Basic functionality test for starting, waiting, and stopping a reminder.

methods.name: Rem_Azure_Basic_Restart
methods.description: Tests stopping and restarting a reminder, verifying counter stability.

methods.name: Rem_Azure_MultipleReminders
methods.description: Tests multiple reminders within a single grain.

methods.name: Rem_Azure_2J_MultiGrainMultiReminders
methods.description: Tests multi-silo multi-grain multi-reminder scenario.

methods.name: Rem_Azure_MultiGrainMultiReminders
methods.description: Tests multiple grains with reminders across multiple silos.

methods.name: Rem_Azure_1F_Basic
methods.description: Test involving starting a reminder, killing a secondary silo, and verifying reminder continues.

methods.name: Rem_Azure_2F_MultiGrain
methods.description: Starts additional silos, signals failure, and verifies reminder resilience across silos.

methods.name: Rem_Azure_1F1J_MultiGrain
methods.description: Tests silo failover and join in a multi-grain reminder setup.

methods.name: Rem_Azure_RegisterSameReminderTwice
methods.description: Verifies behavior when attempting to register the same reminder twice.

methods.name: Rem_Azure_GT_Basic
methods.description: Tests named reminders sharing the same period but different grains.

methods.name: Rem_Azure_GT_1F1J_MultiGrain
methods.description: Tests multi-silo failover and silo join in a mixed reminder setup.

methods.name: Rem_Azure_Wrong_LowerThanAllowedPeriod
methods.description: Verifies error when starting a reminder with a period below minimum allowed.

methods.name: Rem_Azure_Wrong_Grain
methods.description: Verifies error when starting a reminder on an incompatible grain.
